jobs.description:
ELEKS Project Management Office is looking for a Senior Project Manager in Poland, Croatia, or Germany.
 
ABOUT PROJECT
ELEKS is starting a new collaboration with a leading hospital in Germany. The project focuses on the digital transformation of the hospital’s public website and intranet, including the introduction of a new content management system, migration of existing content, and transition into ongoing service operations.
 

REQUIREMENTS

  • At least five years of proven professional experience as a Senior Project Manager in complex digital, web, portal, or CMS projects.

  • At least three years of practical experience as a Scrum Master or Agile Coach.

  • Proven experience in change management and supporting organizational transformation initiatives.

  • Experience managing agile, traditional, and hybrid project delivery models.

  • Solid practical knowledge of Scrum, Kanban, or comparable agile methodologies.

  • Experience with sprint planning, reviews, retrospectives, backlog management, and agile reporting formats.

  • Experience in schedule, budget, quality, risk, dependency, and escalation management.

  • Experience leading and coordinating interdisciplinary and geographically distributed teams.

  • Strong communication skills with executive management, project leadership, business stakeholders, IT, data protection, information security, and external service providers.

  • Hands-on experience with Jira, Confluence, Microsoft Project (or similar planning tools), and Miro.

  • Business-fluent German language skills, minimum C1 level.

  • Very good English language skills for collaboration with international project teams.

  • Reliable availability during the agreed CET/CEST core working hours.

  • Willingness and confirmed availability for approximately ten on-site meetings with the client in Magdeburg during the project duration.


RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Overall responsibility for operational project management and coordination of all involved project teams.

  • Central point of contact for the customer/client.

  • Creation and maintenance of the project management plan, milestone plan, and communication plan.

  • Management of scope, schedule, budget, quality, resources, and dependencies.

  • Establishment and continuous maintenance of the RAID log (Risks, Assumptions, Issues, and Dependencies).

  • Coordination of collaboration between the client, business departments, UX/UI, business analysis, development, quality assurance, DevOps, and other stakeholders.

  • Preparation and facilitation of sprint planning sessions, sprint reviews, retrospectives, and other agile ceremonies.

  • Ensuring transparent and iterative project progress.

  • Conducting daily internal status alignment meetings.

  • Preparation of a weekly written status report.

  • Preparation and facilitation of status meetings, steering committee meetings, and escalation meetings.

  • Stakeholder, risk, change, issue, and escalation management.

  • Management of requirements, decision-making, acceptance, and release processes.

  • Coordination of quality assurance, user acceptance testing (UAT), approvals, go-live, and hypercare activities.

  • Supporting the organization in introducing new processes, systems, and ways of working.

  • Ensuring compliance with contractual, regulatory, data protection, and security requirements.

  • Participation in required on-site meetings in Magdeburg.

jobs.title: Junior Product Owner
jobs.description:
Your journey

ROMEO is the queer company behind the legendary ROMEO dating app, one of Europe’s longest-standing dating platforms for queer communities. We are looking for a Product Owner to join our Product team in Berlin and help shape how ideas and product requirements make their way into the hands of millions of users.

In this delivery-focused role, you will work closely with Product Management, Design, Engineering, QA and BI to turn product priorities into clear, actionable work for our development teams. It is a great opportunity to grow your product skills while taking real ownership of the day-to-day delivery process.


Your typical day

  • Support the Product Management team in refining product requirements and translating approved PRDs into implementation-ready epics, user stories and tickets.
  • Ensure user stories have clear acceptance criteria and are sufficiently refined before entering development.
  • Maintain and order the backlog according to priorities set by product leadership.
  • Take part in regular and ad hoc meetings to clarify product requirements with development, design and other delivery teams.
  • Support our two-week delivery cycle by ensuring development teams have the information and decisions they need to proceed.
  • Identify missing requirements, dependencies, open decisions and blockers early, and escalate them to Product or Delivery.
  • Work closely with QA to communicate product and release priorities, clarify acceptance criteria, and support defect triage and release-readiness decisions.
  • Support product acceptance and release readiness by checking delivered functionality against agreed requirements and acceptance criteria.
  • Support the BI team by translating product questions, KPIs and tracking needs into clear data requirements.
  • Ensure agreed analytics requirements are captured as part of delivery, including relevant event tracking before work is considered complete.
  • Maintain clear and up-to-date product documentation in Jira and Confluence.


We look for

  • You are passionate about building products for LGBTQ+ communities and interested in contributing to the continued development of ROMEO.
  • You have initial experience in a Product Owner or similar product delivery role, ideally in a B2C environment. Experience in social, dating or community products is a plus. Being familiar with how our product works is a plus.
  • You have experience writing or refining user stories and acceptance criteria.
  • You have a good understanding of Agile product development and ideally hands-on experience with Scrum and/or Kanban.
  • You are comfortable working with Jira and Confluence. Experience with Xray is a plus.
  • You are organised, detail-oriented and reliable in following work through to completion.
  • You proactively follow up on missing information and drive requirements towards clarity.
  • You are based in Berlin or willing to relocate and are happy to work from our Wittenbergplatz office at least three days per week.
  • You have excellent written and spoken English skills, ideally at a native or near-native level.


What We Offer

  • A hands-on role working on an established European digital product during a significant phase of product and technology transformation.
  • Close collaboration with Product, Design, Engineering, QA and BI,
  • Hybrid working (3 days per week in our Berlin office at Wittenbergplatz)
  • €40 employer contribution towards the Germany Job Ticket
  • EGYM Wellpass (only €20/month employee contribution)
  • In-house German classes
  • Annual learning budget (e.g. for conferences, courses, certifications)
  • International team, English-speaking environment

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager (f/m/d)
Product Manager On-Ramp & Swap (100% remote)
jobs.description:
Join Tether and Shape the Future of Digital Finance

At Tether, we’re not just building products, we’re pioneering a global financial revolution. Our cutting-edge solutions empower businesses—from exchanges and wallets to payment processors and ATMs—to seamlessly integrate reserve-backed tokens across blockchains. By harnessing the power of blockchain technology, Tether enables you to store, send, and receive digital tokens instantly, securely, and globally, all at a fraction of the cost. Transparency is the bedrock of everything we do, ensuring trust in every transaction.

Innovate with Tether

Tether Finance: Our innovative product suite features the world’s most trusted stablecoin, USDT, relied upon by hundreds of millions worldwide, alongside pioneering digital asset tokenization services.

But that’s just the beginning:

Tether Power: Driving sustainable growth, our energy solutions optimize excess power for Bitcoin mining using eco-friendly practices in state-of-the-art, geo-diverse facilities.

Tether Data: Fueling breakthroughs in AI and peer-to-peer technology, we reduce infrastructure costs and enhance global communications with cutting-edge solutions like KEET, our flagship app that redefines secure and private data sharing.

Tether Education: Democratizing access to top-tier digital learning, we empower individuals to thrive in the digital and gig economies, driving global growth and opportunity.

Tether Evolution: At the intersection of technology and human potential, we are pushing the boundaries of what is possible, crafting a future where innovation and human capabilities merge in powerful, unprecedented ways.

Why Join Us?

Our team is a global talent powerhouse, working remotely from every corner of the world. If you’re passionate about making a mark in the fintech space, this is your opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds, pushing boundaries and setting new standards. We’ve grown fast, stayed lean, and secured our place as a leader in the industry.

If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you.

Are you ready to be part of the future?

About the job

Tether Wallet is our self-custodial wallet, built to bring USDT and XAUT directly to the people who rely on Tether every day, especially in markets where access to stable money and savings is hardest. For that to work, getting into these assets has to be simple, fast and affordable. Our goal is to give every Tether Wallet user the best option to exchange any local currency or token into USDT and XAUT, wherever they are.

In this role, you will define and own the strategy for buying and swapping into USDT and XAUT across our target markets. You will work hand in hand with our expansion teams to map the payment landscape in each market: which payment methods people actually use, which card schemes and bank rails dominate, and which on-ramp and swap providers can serve them. Based on that, you will identify the best partner for each market and bring them on board as a service partner of Tether Wallet.

This role sits at the intersection of product, payments and partnerships. You will own the outcome end to end, from the first partner evaluation through integration and the in-app experience to the conversion numbers after launch. If you enjoy turning a fragmented global payments landscape into a buy button that just works, we want to hear from you.

Key responsibilities:

  • Buy & Swap Strategy: Define and own the strategy and roadmap for buying and swapping into USDT and XAUT in Tether Wallet, covering fiat on-ramps, card payments, local payment methods and token-to-token swaps.

  • Market & Payment Landscape: Work with our expansion teams to build a deep understanding of each target market, including dominant payment methods, card schemes, bank transfer and instant payment rails, mobile money, local regulation, and the on-ramp and swap providers active there.

  • Partner Evaluation & Selection: Define clear evaluation criteria such as market and payment method coverage, fees and FX spreads, approval and conversion rates, KYC experience, settlement speed, reliability and compliance standing, and use them to select the best on-ramp or swap partner for each market.

  • Partner Onboarding: Lead selected partners from evaluation to go-live as service partners of Tether Wallet, coordinating with Legal, Compliance and Business Development on due diligence, commercial terms and contracts.

  • Integration & Delivery: Translate partner capabilities and APIs into clear product requirements, user stories and acceptance criteria, and work with engineering and design to deliver a seamless in-app buy and swap experience.

  • Routing & Optimization: Define the logic that decides which partner and payment method a user is offered based on country, currency, amount, price and availability, so every user gets the best available option.

  • Performance & Partner Management: Define and track KPIs across the buy and swap funnel, such as conversion, payment approval rates, KYC drop-off, total cost to the user and volume by market and partner. Use the data to improve the experience, manage partner performance and incidents, and regularly review whether each market still has the right partner.


Mandatory:

  • 5+ years of product management experience in the financial industry (banking, payment service provider, FinTech)

  • 3+ years of product management experience in DeFi or crypto industry

  • Good understanding of crypto wallets and DeFi features, including token swaps, DEX aggregators and on-chain transaction flows.

  • Good understanding of global payment systems and credit card schemes (e.g. Visa, Mastercard), including authorization, 3-D Secure and chargebacks, as well as local payment methods such as bank transfers, instant payment rails and mobile money.

  • Hands-on experience with fiat on-ramp, off-ramp or swap providers, or with integrating third-party payment providers and gateways into a consumer product.

  • Proven experience evaluating, selecting and onboarding external partners, and managing their performance after launch.

  • Working knowledge of KYC/AML requirements and how they affect user onboarding and conversion.

  • Technical enough to read partner API documentation, assess integration options and work closely with engineering teams.

  • Data-driven: experience defining funnel KPIs and using data to improve conversion and make partner decisions.

  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to work effectively with partners, expansion teams and engineers across time zones in a remote environment.

Important information for candidates
Recruitment scams have become increasingly common. To protect yourself, please keep the following in mind when applying for roles:

  • Apply only through our official channels. We do not use third-party platforms or agencies for recruitment unless clearly stated. All open roles are listed on our official careers page: https://tether.recruitee.com/

  • Verify the recruiter’s identity. All our recruiters have verified LinkedIn profiles. If you’re unsure, you can confirm their identity by checking their profile or contacting us through our website.

  • Be cautious of unusual communication methods. We do not conduct interviews over WhatsApp, Telegram, or SMS. All communication is done through official company emails and platforms.

  • Double-check email addresses. All communication from us will come from emails ending in @tether.to or @tether.io

  • We will never request payment or financial details. If someone asks for personal financial information or payment at any point during the hiring process, it is a scam. Please report it immediately.

When in doubt, feel free to reach out through our official website.

jobs.title: Delivery Manager
jobs.description:
Join REMATIQ in revolutionizing medical innovation.

Join us on our mission to help medical innovators bring life-saving products to market faster and safer.

 

About REMATIQ

REMATIQ builds AI software for life sciences and medical device companies. Our platform helps teams automate complex documentation and compliance workflows, while keeping outputs traceable, reviewable, and audit-ready.

 

Product development in MedTech is highly complex: teams need to manage requirements, documentation, quality processes, regulatory expectations, and internal reviews across many systems and stakeholders. REMATIQ helps customers simplify this work, reduce manual effort, and move faster without compromising on quality or compliance.

 

We work with some of the world’s leading life sciences and MedTech companies, including Philips, Siemens Healthineers, B. Braun, and Novartis. We are backed by exceptional investors, having recently closed a Series A round.

 

This role will have a vital part in the shaping and growth of the Delivery organization with building up Customer Success, Support Engineering structures and also working towards internationalizing REMATIQ.

 

We believe in the value of in-person collaboration and work in a hybrid setup, with the team coming together in our office in the heart of Berlin-Mitte typically four days per week.

 

What you’ll do

As a Delivery Manager at REMATIQ, you will independently drive customer projects from problem framing to successful delivery. You will work closely with customers, our leadership team, Forward Deployed Engineers, MedTech Domain Experts, Product, and Engineering to turn complex customer needs into high-quality AI-powered workflows.

This is a hands-on project ownership role. You should be savvy and comfortable working with AI, software, implementation topics, and complex regulated workflows, but you will not be expected to be the technical expert or the MedTech domain expert.

 

You will:

  • Own customer delivery workstreams: Structure ambiguous problems, define the workplan, align stakeholders, manage risks, and drive projects to successful outcomes.

  • Lead customer interactions: Work directly with customer project teams and subject-matter experts to understand their goals, workflows, constraints, pain points, and success criteria.

  • Work hands-on with a cutting-edge AI platform: Deploy agents in mission-critical workflows at some of the world’s most innovative MedTech and life sciences companies.

  • Bring structure and insight: Frame complex issues clearly, break them down into practical next steps, push for insight, and turn ambiguity into decisions.

  • Create high-quality outputs quickly: Produce project plans, meeting materials, workflow documentation, decision documents, customer-facing drafts, internal summaries, and scalable delivery templates.

  • Become fluent in the REMATIQ product: Demo it, explain it, teach it, support customers after rollout, capture feedback, and identify opportunities for additional use cases.

 

What we’re looking for

We are looking for a top performer with exceptional project ownership, analytical horsepower, customer presence, and execution speed.

You may be a strong fit if you have:

 

  • Relevant background: 2–4 years in consulting, enterprise implementation, customer-facing project delivery, or a high-growth B2B SaaS / AI company, ideally in strategy, technology, transformation, or life sciences contexts.

  • Strong project ownership: You can take an ambiguous problem, structure it, identify what matters, define the workplan, and drive execution with limited guidance.

  • Excellent problem-solving skills: You are strong at conceptual framing, analysis, synthesis, and turning complex information into clear recommendations.

  • Strong customer presence: You can interact independently with customer project teams, build trust, manage expectations, and communicate clearly in meetings and written updates.

  • High execution quality and AI-native working style: You create strong drafts and polished deliverables quickly, and actively use AI tools to analyze, synthesize, improve outputs, and increase your own productivity.

  • Comfort with software and implementation topics: You are curious, fast-learning, and confident working with product, data, workflows, and AI-enabled solutions.

  • Startup mindset: You are adaptable, resilient, hands-on, positive under pressure, and willing to take on challenges beyond a narrow job description.

  • Fluency in English and German (mandatory).

 

Why join REMATIQ?

  • Rare timing: Join one of Europe’s fastest-growing AI companies at a pivotal stage as we move from Seed toward Series A and prepare to significantly grow the team.

  • Real ownership: Own high-impact customer projects and see your work translate directly into outcomes for leading MedTech and life sciences companies.

  • Unmatched exposure: Work directly with founders, customers, product teams, and technical experts while building a network across the global MedTech and life sciences industry.

  • Purposeful work: Be part of a mission-driven team transforming how medical devices reach the market — in an industry where quality, compliance, and patient safety mean nothing can be left to chance.

  • Compensation & growth: Competitive salary plus equity, giving you a stake in the success you help create.

Radiant is redefining how AI infrastructure is built.

We are building purpose-built AI infrastructure from powered land, to compute, to software.

As we scale our operations and deploy capital into the next generation of AI infrastructure, we are looking to expand our finance team with leaders who can combine technical strength with execution excellence and are driven to build.

Radiant was established by Brookfield, a leading global alternative asset manager with over US$1 trillion of assets under management across real estate, infrastructure, renewable power and transition, private equity and credit. Brookfield's global relationships, investment expertise and access to long-term institutional capital provide Radiant with a differentiated platform from which to develop, finance and operate AI infrastructure assets. This combination of entrepreneurial execution and institutional sponsorship enables Radiant to pursue large-scale GPU and AI infrastructure opportunities globally.

As a Senior/Principal Product Manager - Infrastructure, you will own the roadmap, prioritisation, and delivery of the core infrastructure that underpins Radiant’s platform.

You’ll work closely with platform engineering, software engineering, networking, SRE, security, and infrastructure teams across Kubernetes, networking, storage, and shared platform services.

What you bring:

  • Systems thinking: Understand dependencies and downstream impact across the platform.

  • Prioritisation: Balance product delivery with reliability, maintenance, security, and technical debt.

Our values:

  • You’re real and you’re true to yourself: We cherish and celebrate diversity so you’ll feel right at home whoever you are and whoever you’re talking to, you treat everyone the same.

Why should you join us?

What sets us apart is our blend of modern technology, competitive benefits, and an open, welcoming work culture that enables our people to thrive.

jobs.description:
Join Tether and Shape the Future of Digital Finance

At Tether, we’re not just building products, we’re pioneering a global financial revolution. Our cutting-edge solutions empower businesses—from exchanges and wallets to payment processors and ATMs—to seamlessly integrate reserve-backed tokens across blockchains. Innovate with Tether

Tether Finance: Our innovative product suite features the world’s most trusted stablecoin, USDT, relied upon by hundreds of millions worldwide, alongside pioneering digital asset tokenization services.

But that’s just the beginning:

Tether Power: Driving sustainable growth, our energy solutions optimize excess power for Bitcoin mining using eco-friendly practices in state-of-the-art, geo-diverse facilities.

Tether Data: Fueling breakthroughs in AI and peer-to-peer technology, we reduce infrastructure costs and enhance global communications with cutting-edge solutions like KEET, our flagship app that redefines secure and private data sharing.

Tether Education: Democratizing access to top-tier digital learning, we empower individuals to thrive in the digital and gig economies, driving global growth and opportunity.

Tether Evolution: At the intersection of technology and human potential, we are pushing the boundaries of what is possible, crafting a future where innovation and human capabilities merge in powerful, unprecedented ways.

Why Join Us?

Our team is a global talent powerhouse, working remotely from every corner of the world. If you’re passionate about making a mark in the fintech space, this is your opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds, pushing boundaries and setting new standards. We’ve grown fast, stayed lean, and secured our place as a leader in the industry.

If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you.

Are you ready to be part of the future?

About the job

QV.AC is a general purpose AI assistant that runs locally on your devices, it gives users greater control over their data and how they use artificial intelligence. Our focus is on local, on-device, and privacy-preserving AI, with opportunities to connect these experiences across Tether’s peer-to-peer ecosystem.

We’re looking for a Product Manager with a strong interest in AI and a practical understanding of how to turn emerging capabilities into useful products.

You will work closely with the Product Lead to help advance the QV.AC vision: identifying valuable use cases, defining AI features, exploring product concepts, and working with engineering and design to bring them to users. You’ll contribute to product direction and take responsibility for moving assigned features from discovery through delivery and iteration.

This role suits someone who knows how to leverage AI to the maximum and enjoys experimenting with new AI technologies, understands its possibilities and limitations, and cares about making complex technology easy to use.

Responsibilities

  • Help shape AI features: Work with the Product Lead to translate the QV.AC vision into concrete use cases, feature proposals, and product requirements. Bring ideas grounded in user needs, research, and hands-on experimentation.

  • Understand users and their problems: Gather feedback, conduct research, and explore how people use AI in their everyday workflows. Identify where AI can solve a meaningful problem and where a simpler solution may work better.

  • Turn ideas into clear specifications: Write product briefs, user stories, acceptance criteria, and user flows that help engineering and design understand the intended experience, constraints, and measures of success.

  • Prototype and explore: Create wireframes, mockups, and working prototypes to test ideas and communicate product behavior. Use AI-assisted tools to explore concepts quickly and refine them with the team.

  • Collaborate on technical trade-offs: Work with engineers to understand what is feasible across devices and models. Help assess the impact of response quality, latency, memory usage, battery consumption, and privacy on the user experience.

  • Support prioritization and planning: Help the Product Lead evaluate opportunities, clarify scope, identify dependencies, and maintain a focused backlog aligned with product priorities.

  • Drive feature delivery: Follow assigned features through development, resolve product questions, review the experience, and coordinate feedback and release readiness with relevant teams.

  • Stay close to AI developments: Explore new AI products, models, tools, and interaction patterns, and explain their practical relevance to QV.AC. Share clear recommendations about what is worth testing or adopting and why.


Mandatory:

  • 7+ years of product management experience, ideally working on AI software products with technical engineering teams.

  • Practical experience building, shipping, or prototyping AI-powered features, with the ability to explain your contribution and what you learned.

  • A working understanding of AI concepts such as inference, harnesses, model capabilities and limitations, context, and evaluation, alongside an interest in local and on-device AI.

  • The ability to translate an ambiguous idea into a clear user problem, proposed solution, and actionable requirements.

  • Strong product judgment, with attention to usability, scope, and measurable user value.

  • Confidence creating prototypes using design or coding tools

  • Clear written and verbal communication, including the ability to discuss technical trade-offs with engineers and explain them to non-technical colleagues.

  • A proactive, collaborative approach: comfortable taking responsibility for your work, asking questions early, and incorporating feedback.

  • Familiarity with product analytics, user research, and iterative software development.

Preferred:

  • Experience with local AI, on-device inference, or open-source models.

  • Experience building AI assistants, conversational interfaces, or multimodal features.

  • Familiarity with desktop or mobile product development.

  • An understanding of peer-to-peer technologies and decentralized applications.

  • Experience evaluating AI output quality and designing user experiences that account for uncertainty and errors.

  • Experience working in a distributed team.

Important information for candidates
Recruitment scams have become increasingly common. To protect yourself, please keep the following in mind when applying for roles:

  • Apply only through our official channels. We do not use third-party platforms or agencies for recruitment unless clearly stated. All open roles are listed on our official careers page: https://tether.recruitee.com/

  • Verify the recruiter’s identity. All our recruiters have verified LinkedIn profiles. If you’re unsure, you can confirm their identity by checking their profile or contacting us through our website.

  • Be cautious of unusual communication methods. We do not conduct interviews over WhatsApp, Telegram, or SMS. All communication is done through official company emails and platforms.

  • Double-check email addresses. All communication from us will come from emails ending in @tether.to or @tether.io

  • We will never request payment or financial details. If someone asks for personal financial information or payment at any point during the hiring process, it is a scam. Please report it immediately.

When in doubt, feel free to reach out through our official website.

You’ll work across object, block, and file storage, data lifecycle, performance, resilience, APIs, and platform integrations, partnering closely with engineering, infrastructure, SRE, networking, security, commercial teams, and customers.

  • Work with customers and internal teams to understand workload requirements around capacity, throughput, latency, resilience, and cost.

  • Drive integrations with compute, Kubernetes, IAM, observability, and developer tooling.

  • Own prioritisation, delivery, launch, adoption, and continuous iteration.

  • Define success metrics across performance, reliability, utilisation, adoption, and unit economics.

    • Infrastructure: Kubernetes, containers, networking, cloud platforms

    • Reliability: durability, availability, consistency, failure recovery

    • Observability & security: metrics, logging, IAM, encryption, auditability

  • Familiarity with technologies such as Weka, Vast, DDN, MinIO, Lustre, Pure Storage, or similar.

  • Able to reason about trade-offs between performance, durability, availability, cost, and operational complexity.

jobs.title: Product Owner (H/F/N)
jobs.description:
Les entreprises qui performent décident mieux. Depuis 2006, Ekimetrics aide les organisations à transformer leurs décisions en avantage concurrentiel durable grâce à des solutions d’IA. Notre double ambition est d’allier performance et durabilité, pour construire un leadership pérenne. 

Nos solutions sont une combinaison unique de People et de technologie. Notre plateforme Eki.Decisions complète l’expertise de nos équipes en marketing, efficacité commerciale et data science, pour connecter l’IA aux décisions qui structurent toute l’organisation. 

Avec une équipe 100% internalisée et des bureaux à Paris, Londres, New York, Hong Kong et Shanghai, nous nous engageons pour une IA responsable et frugale, pour garantir un avantage concurrentiel constant, et pour rester fidèles à nos valeurs et à notre ADN. 

Vous rejoignez l’équipe Produit – R&PD 

Au sein de l’équipe R&PD (Research & Product Development) nous concevons et industrialisons des solutions Data & IA SaaS à fort impact business, qui répondent aux enjeux de nos clients grâce à l’analytics, la data science et l’intelligence artificielle.

A ce titre, nous recrutons un·e Product Owner pour notre solution Marketing Effectiveness avec pour objectif de structurer la  roadmap produit, maximiser son adoption, son time-to-market et la valeur délivrée à nos clients. 

Votre rôle dans l’équipe 

Product Owner de notre solution Marketing Effectiveness (Eki.Decisions), vous transformez les besoins business, marché et utilisateurs en fonctionnalités concrètes, documentées et alignées sur une logique de plateforme commune. 

Vous travaillez au quotidien avec le Product Manager, les équipes engineering et data, ainsi que les équipes projet et delivery, pour construire une solution fiable, adoptée et scalable. 

Vos principales missions 

Piloter le backlog et le delivery 

  • Structurer, prioriser et maintenir le backlog de la solution 

  • Rédiger les user stories, spécifications fonctionnelles et critères d’acceptance 

  • Clarifier les besoins avec l’engineering et accompagner chaque livraison de bout en bout 

  • Suivre l’avancement, lever les blocages et sécuriser les engagements 

  • Animer les rituels agiles : refinement, sprint planning, reviews, rétrospectives, synchronisations produit/tech 

  • Rendre la roadmap, les priorités et les arbitrages lisibles pour toutes les parties prenantes 

Contribuer à la vision produit 

  • Co-construire la vision et la roadmap avec le Product Manager 

  • Traduire les enjeux business et marché en opportunités produit concrètes : fonctionnalités, parcours utilisateurs, briques mutualisées, standards d’expérience 

  • Prioriser selon la valeur business, l’impact client, la contribution à la platformisation et la capacité à accélérer le time-to-market 

Participer à la product discovery 

  • Comprendre les besoins des utilisateurs et des clients sur le Marketing Effectiveness 

  • Maîtriser les usages, comportements et règles métier qui font la valeur de la solution 

  • Identifier les enjeux fonctionnels et opérationnels : expérience utilisateur, cohérence des parcours, adoption, scalabilité, industrialisation 

  • Conduire ou contribuer aux activités de discovery : interviews, retours terrain, analyses d’usage, benchmarks 

Faire adopter et améliorer en continu 

  • Accompagner le déploiement des nouvelles fonctionnalités auprès des parties prenantes clés, avec une communication claire sur ce qui est livré 

  • Mesurer l’impact : adoption, satisfaction, valeur délivrée aux clients 

  • Animer la boucle de feedback avec les équipes Produit, Business, Tech et Delivery 

  • S’appuyer sur les outils de tracking pour monitorer les usages et prioriser de façon data-driven 

  • Garantir la qualité : documentation produit, release notes, support, monitoring d’usage 

Collaborer en transverse 

  • Travailler avec les équipes Produit, Tech, Data, IA et Delivery pour assurer la cohérence des solutions émergentes avec la plateforme 

  • Servir de relais entre les équipes business, produit, engineering et delivery 

  • Participer aux démonstrations, formations internes, retours d’expérience et communications produit 

Votre profil 

Expérience 

  • 3 ans minimum en tant que Product Owner ou Product Manager 

  • Expérience sur des produits SaaS ou digitaux, idéalement dans un environnement data, IA ou tech

Compétences 

  • Forte appétence business : vous reliez les fonctionnalités à la valeur client et aux enjeux marché 

  • Aisance avec les profils tech : vous comprenez les enjeux d’un produit technique, sans avoir besoin d’être développeur·se 

  • Maîtrise du backlog : clarifier les besoins, prioriser des sujets complexes, suivre le delivery 

  • Logique de plateforme : mutualisation des usages, convergence des solutions, cohérence des parcours 

  • Sensibilité forte à l’expérience utilisateur, à l’adoption et à la qualité produit 

  • Capacité à vulgariser et à embarquer les parties prenantes autour d’une vision commune 

Savoir-être 

  • Organisé·e, rigoureux·se, autonome, curieux·se et orienté·e impact 

Langues 

  • Français et anglais courants, à l’écrit comme à l’oral 

Pourquoi nous rejoindre ?  

Chez Ekimetrics, vos idées comptent vraiment et vous appartiennent: à vous de leur donner vie. Nous cultivons un esprit entrepreneurial qui vous encourage à repousser les limites pour créer un impact significatif. 

Mais il ne s’agit pas seulement de réussites individuelles : nous avançons ensemble, en nous enrichissant mutuellement. Ensemble, nous apprenons et progressons en continu, que ce soit à travers des parcours de carrière personnalisés, des projets stimulants, du mentorat, ou simplement grâce à la diversité des perspectives que chacun.e apporte.

Et surtout, nous croyons au plaisir dans le travail. Ekimetrics est un environnement stimulant et bienveillant, où chacun.e peut s’épanouir en étant pleinement soi-même.

En 2023, Ekimetrics a obtenu le statut d’entreprise à mission qui témoigne de notre ambition forte en matière de RSE. Notre raison d’être : Faire de la data science et de l’intelligence artificielle l’accélérateur de la transformation durable des organisations.

Ekimetrics fait partie du classement French Tech 120 ! Nous avons été sélectionnés par La French Tech pour rejoindre le prestigieux groupe des 120 scale-ups françaises les plus performantes, avec un fort potentiel pour devenir des leaders internationaux.  

Vous aurez accès :

  • Au catalogue de formation Eki.Academy qui contient des programmes qui vous feront monter en compétences sur nos solutions et nos métiers, des parcours apprenants sur notre plateforme digitale ainsi que des programmes dédiés à nos enjeux prioritaires, dont la sensibilisation aux sujets environnementaux avec la Climate School.
  • A une vie sportive, artistique, musicale, ludique, caritative et engagée : de notre salle de sport privatisée à nos expositions d’art, en passant par des jeux vidéo et des concerts, ou encore les défis RSE sur la plateforme Vendredi. Toutes ces initiatives sont portées par nos Eki.People.
  • De nombreux évènements et séminaires pour rester proche de votre communauté.
  • Des locaux chaleureux dans un quartier dynamique au cœur de Paris (Grands boulevards).
  • Une politique de télétravail flexible, avec 3 jours de présence obligatoire par tranche de 15 jours.
 

En tant qu’employeur, Ekimetrics offre à tous les mêmes opportunités d’accès à l’emploi sans distinction de genre, ethnicité, religion, orientation sexuelle, statut social, handicap et d’âge. Ekimetrics veille à développer un environnement de travail inclusif qui reflète la diversité dans ses équipes.

jobs.title: Project Manager
jobs.description:
Join BLP and help make the world’s business processes autonomous!

Our agentic platform helps finance and operations teams worldwide remove manual work from their core business processes, so work runs end-to-end with greater control and significant productivity gains.

Today, over 550 enterprise customers use BLP across 1,300+ deployed projects. In the processes we automate, customers achieve productivity improvements of 5 to 10 times.

To date, BLP remains majority employee-owned, with Goldman Sachs holding a minority stake as a growth investor. Our success is driven by deep expertise in technology and business processes, a superior product with strong product-market fit, reflected in an expanding customer base that includes Fortune 500 companies.

BLP is one of Switzerland's fastest-growing SaaS scale-ups; we are now entering our next phase of growth. From our headquarters on Zürich's Bahnhofstrasse, we're expanding globally, with a growing presence across Europe and North America.

Join us and help make autonomous operations the new standard.

Location

This is a full-time position based in Munich or Cologne. Following a comprehensive onboarding period at our HQ in central Zurich (minimum one month), you will work from your home location, with regular visits to customers across the DACH region.

Team collaboration matters a lot to us. You will regularly spend time with the team in person, in Zurich and at our hubs, for team days, all-hands and offsites. These visits are financially supported by blp.

Your Mission

You get customers live. Hands on, end to end, and fast.

As a Project Manager, most of your implementations are not multi-year global programs. They are for companies that want blp running in their finance or supply chain organization within weeks, and who want somebody who knows what they are doing to take them through it. You are that person. You run the kick-off, work with them on scope and process, configure blp, coordinate the integration, take them through testing, and get them across the line at go-live.

You work in three modes, and many of our Project Managers move between them:

  • Guided onboarding for our commercial customers: you run configuration days for several customers at once, guide them while they configure, and answer the questions that come up.

  • Leading yourself on enterprise customers: you own the project end to end, including the sponsor meetings.

  • Alongside a Senior Project Manager on our largest programs, where you take a country, an entity or a workstream and own it.

Your Career Path in Project Management

This is the path most of our delivery leadership came through, and we hire at every step of it. We place you according to your experience and the size of the programs you have delivered, and we are explicit about what the next step requires.

  • Project Manager: You get customers live end to end, several in parallel: guided onboarding for commercial customers, leading enterprise projects yourself, or a workstream on our largest programs. Typically you bring 2+ years in consulting, implementation or project management.

  • Senior Project Manager: You make large, global transformations happen: multiple ERPs, entities and countries, the steering committee, and a blp team on each engagement. Typically you bring 5+ years delivering complex, multi-country programs.

  • Next steps: Lead a delivery team, or move into Consulting and from there towards our Client Partner role on strategic accounts.

Moves into Consulting or Customer Success Engineering are open at every level, and many of our people make them.

Key Responsibilities

  • Run implementations end to end: kick-off, scope, planning, configuration, testing and go-live.

  • Manage several customers in parallel at different stages, and keep every one of them on date.

  • Work with customers on their processes, and flag early where a process assumption will not hold.

jobs.title: Staff Product Manager: Product Discovery Engine
jobs.description:
Staff Product Manager, Product Discovery Engine

About Us

Constructor powers product search and discovery for some of the largest retailers in the world. We serve billions of requests every week, and you’ve probably seen our results somewhere and used our product without knowing it. We differentiate ourselves by focusing on metrics over features, and reinventing search and discovery from the ground up as a machine learning challenge with the specific goal of improving metrics like revenue. We’re approximately doubling year over year despite the market slowing down and have customers in every eCommerce vertical. We’re a passionate team of technologists who love solving problems and want to make our customers’ and coworkers’ lives better. We value empathy, openness, curiosity, continuous improvement, and are excited by metrics that matter. We believe that empowering everyone in a company to do what they think is best can lead to great things.

Job Summary

We’re looking for a systems-minded Staff Product Manager to take Constructor’s search and discovery to the state of the art — and keep it there — across every retail industry we serve. This is a highly technical, high-leverage role at the core of our Product Discovery Engine chapter: the teams responsible for how we retrieve, understand, and rank the right products for every shopper, on every query, for every customer.

Your job is to raise discovery quality and, through it, our customers’ business metrics. You won’t be measured on features shipped — you’ll be measured on relevance and business outcomes, like conversion, revenue per visit, and search-attributed GMV, moving up.

You’ll start embedded with our Search Quality team, owning its strategy and roadmap and getting deep into the systems that decide what shoppers actually see. Over time, your mandate grows to setting direction for the entire Product Discovery Engine chapter — deciding where we’re heading and why across recall, ranking, query understanding, personalization, and the ML infrastructure underneath. This is a Staff role today with a clear path to Director as you take on chapter-wide leadership.

Search at Constructor is fundamentally a machine learning problem, so this role lives and breathes ML. You’ll partner closely with ML, data science, and engineering to turn the latest research into production wins, keep us ahead of both commercial competitors and academic state of the art, and be the connective tissue that aligns multiple teams — ML Recall, ML Infra, and, over time, teams like CORE, SABR, and Catalog Management — behind a single, coherent vision for great discovery.

If you’re excited about driving innovation across dozens of the world’s largest retailers, being held to relevance and business outcomes, and pushing an already best-in-class product further ahead, this role is for you.

What You’ll Do

  • Own business impact, not features. Drive measurable lift in search-attributed conversion, revenue per visit, and GMV alongside relevance across our customer base.

  • Deliver across every retail industry. Move quality and business metrics across all the verticals we serve, accounting for the differences in catalog, language, and shopper intent.

  • Keep us at the state of the art. Continuously translate the latest ML / IR research and competitive moves into production wins, and ship SOTA ML / LLM-assisted capabilities that beat our previous best on relevance.

  • Set chapter vision and strategy. Define the multi-quarter direction for the Product Discovery Engine — where we’re heading and why — tie it directly to customer business outcomes, and rally teams behind it.

  • Lead Search Quality first. Own its strategy and roadmap, driving measurable improvements in the relevance and correctness of results.

  • Orchestrate across the pipeline. Unify recall, ranking, query understanding, and personalization behind one definition of quality and one set of business metrics, so improvements compound instead of colliding.

  • Turn ML research into production wins. Partner deeply with ML and data science to take models — from candidate generation and recall to LLM-assisted interpretation — from idea to production, balancing accuracy, latency, and cost.

  • Make quality measurable and explainable. Build the metrics, evaluation frameworks, and tooling the whole chapter uses to measure, attribute, and explain discovery quality and its business impact.

  • Own quality under pressure. Lead investigation and triage when issues arise, and design durable, systemic fixes rather than one-off patches.

  • Grow the mandate. Expand into chapter-wide leadership spanning ML Recall, ML Infra, and — over time — teams like CORE, SABR, and Catalog Management.

What Success Looks Like

Within your first year, you will have:

  • Driven measurable lift in search-attributed conversion and revenue per visit — moving business metrics, not just quality metrics.

  • Driven measurable business-metric lift (conversion, revenue per visit, GMV) and relevance lift across every major retail vertical we serve.

  • Shipped at least one state-of-the-art ML / LLM-assisted capability into production that beats our previous best on relevance.

  • Won head-to-head quality benchmarks against every major competitor in the verticals we compete in, with a repeatable, defensible methodology.

  • Taken core quality metrics to best-in-class levels and kept them improving quarter over quarter.

  • Stood up an evaluation framework and tooling that ties model and system investments directly to customer business outcomes.

What We’re Looking For

  • Extensive product management experience (typically 8+ years) in search, discovery, ML, or NLP-heavy products, including time operating at a senior or staff level.

  • A track record of moving business metrics at scale — conversion, revenue, engagement — not just shipping features, and of setting strategy across multiple teams.

  • Deep understanding of the end-to-end search pipeline: query interpretation → recall / candidate generation → ranking → reranking → personalization → delivery.

  • Strong ML product depth — owning production models and reasoning about tradeoffs between high-capacity (LLM / batch) and low-latency (real-time) approaches — and a habit of staying current with state-of-the-art research.

  • Fluency with retrieval and recall, query understanding (tokenization, synonyms, spelling correction, multilingual support), and search evaluation frameworks.

  • A rigorous, measurement-first mindset that ties every quality investment back to business outcomes.

  • Excellent cross-functional leadership — able to align teams with different goals behind a shared definition of quality and a shared set of business metrics, working shoulder-to-shoulder with engineering, data science, and ML Ops.

  • Comfort operating with ambiguity, setting direction where none exists yet, and leading through clarity and credibility rather than the org chart.

Benefits

  • Unlimited vacation time — we strongly encourage all of our employees to take at least 3 weeks per year.

  • A competitive compensation package including stock options.

  • Company-sponsored US health coverage (100% paid for employee).

  • Fully remote team — choose where you live.

  • Work-from-home stipend! We want you to have the resources you need to set up your home office.

  • Apple laptops provided for new employees.

  • Training and development budget for every employee, refreshed each year.

  • Parental leave for qualified employees.

  • Work with smart people who will help you grow and make a meaningful impact.

This position is fully remote — Constructor.io is a remote-first company.

Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion at Constructor

At Constructor.io we are committed to cultivating a work environment that is diverse, equitable, and inclusive. As an equal opportunity employer, we welcome individuals of all backgrounds and provide equal opportunities to all applicants regardless of their education, diversity of opinion, race, color, religion, gender, gender expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, veteran status or affiliation in any other protected group.

How we handle your data. By submitting this application, you acknowledge that Constructor will collect and process the personal data you provide for the purpose of evaluating your candidacy for this role. If you are not selected, we will retain your data for a limited period as described in our Recruitment Privacy Notice. After that period your data will be deleted or anonymized.

jobs.title: Staff Product Manager
jobs.description:
Unleash AI Innovators, Securely

Software is being rewritten in real time. AI agents are starting to write more code than humans do, at a speed no security team has ever had to match, and that single shift is opening up the biggest opportunity our industry has seen in a decade. We're not bracing for it, we're building the company that owns it.

Snyk is building the next generation security platform where security isn't a set of tools people operate. It's a team of security agents working alongside your engineers, finding, fixing, and governing risk at the speed software is now built. These agents work alongside both the company build and the agents they adopt. Security stops being a queue of work waiting for people, and becomes a coordinated workforce companies direct and trust.

Why this role?

 

As a Staff Product Manager in Snyk's Agent Security division, you'll play a pivotal role in shaping how modern organizations build and secure AI applications at scale. You'll join a collaborative, forward-thinking team and help drive our mission to embed security into every part of the AI-native development lifecycle. This is a unique opportunity to shape early-stage products from the ground up, operating with the agility of a startup while leveraging the scale of an industry leader.

What You’ll Do

  • Lead new product discovery from idea to execution by partnering with engineers, designers, and customers to identify high-potential opportunities in AI security and beyond.

  • Validate problem-solution fit by designing lean experiments and MVPs to quickly validate customer problems and solution approaches.

  • Shape the vision and roadmap for the capabilities that you own, balancing short-term experiments with long-term strategic bets.

  • Influence the broader innovation agenda by presenting roadmap and strategy to customers, leadership, and internal stakeholders.

  • Collaborate cross-functionally with engineering, design, and go-to-market teams to take new ideas from concept to product-market fit.

What You Bring

  • You have solid experience in technology, with strong experience in a product management role.

  • You bring a strong technical background and the ability to engage deeply with engineering and AI/ML concepts.

  • You are comfortable with high ambiguity and can design frameworks to execute effectively in fast-moving, uncertain environments.

  • You have a proven track record of taking early-stage products from concept to launch within SaaS or developer tooling.

  • You have strong communication and storytelling skills to influence across teams, leadership, and customers.

It’d Be Awesome If You Also…

  • Have hands-on experience in developer security, AI/ML products, or agentic systems.

  • Contribute to open-source or developer communities.

  • Have a background in software engineering or have worked in a startup or internal incubator environment.

  • Love solving complex problems with a collaborative team.

  • Bring fresh ideas and aren’t afraid to challenge the status quo.

About Snyk

Snyk is committed to creating an inclusive and engaging environment where our employees can thrive as we rally behind our common mission to make the digital world a safer place. From Snyk employee resource groups, to global benefits that help our employees prioritize their health, wellness, financial security, and a work/life blend, we aim to support our employees along their entire journeys here at Snyk.

jobs.title: Global Director of Product
jobs.description:
Help us use technology to make a big green dent in the universe!

Kraken powers some of the most innovative global developments in energy.

We create the technology that redefines utilities and unlocks a new energy system of the future. By optimising renewable generation, building a more intelligent grid, and empowering utilities to deliver an exceptional customer experience, our operating system is transforming the industry worldwide.

It’s an incredibly exciting time to work in energy. Join us on our mission to improve the lives of ONE BILLION humans within the decade and shape a cleaner, better future for everyone.

We are looking for a Global Director of Product for Flex to lead the product strategy, direction, and organisation behind Kraken's global flexibility platform. Kraken Flex connects distributed energy resources to energy markets at scale — operating across Liberalised Markets, where we trade flexibility directly, and Regulated Markets, where we partner with utilities and DSOs to deliver grid services.

This is a pivotal executive product role at the heart of Kraken's fastest-growing business unit. You will own the product direction, roadmap, culture, and delivery effectiveness of the shared Flex platform — the core set of capabilities that both business units depend on to compete and grow.

Your mandate is to evolve the Flex platform into a scalable, differentiated capability that creates long-term strategic advantage: meaningfully ahead of anything the flexibility market has built.

 
 

🏡 Where you'll fit in:

You will lead the product organisation across all shared Flex platform squads — the teams building the core capabilities that underpin Liberalised and Regulated Markets propositions globally. You will work with the VP of Engineering for Flex, together accountable for the quality, culture, and strategic direction of the Flex technology organisation.

The shared platform sits at the intersection of two distinct business models, multiple geographies, and a constantly evolving set of market requirements. The central challenge of this role is making the right calls about what the platform should build, in what sequence, and why — while holding the tension between serving immediate business needs and protecting long-term platform integrity.

 
 

🚀 What you'll own:

  • Product Strategy and Roadmap: Own the product vision and roadmap across all Flex platform squads. Ensure it is genuinely aligned with Flex's long-term strategy and the priorities of both business units — not a backlog of requests from the loudest stakeholder.

  • Cross-BU Alignment: Work alongside Proposition Product Leaders across Liberalised and Regulated Markets to identify what the platform should build to unlock their roadmaps, and which capabilities developed in proposition teams are ready to become shared platform features. Make those calls with clarity and conviction.

  • Platform Strategy: Identify and drive capabilities emerging from proposition teams. Ensure the shared platform evolves toward reusable, composable architecture — balancing immediate delivery needs with long-term platform coherence.

  • Product Culture and Practice: Build and sustain a high-performing product organisation. Define how teams discover, prioritise, and deliver. Mentor Product Managers across Flex, set the bar for product excellence, and create the conditions for PMs to meet it.

  • Competitive Positioning: Maintain a clear picture of where Flex has capability gaps versus alternatives in the market. Own the plans to close those gaps before they become liabilities.

  • Long-Term Differentiation: Look beyond the current roadmap. Identify technology and product investments that create durable, hard-to-replicate advantage for Kraken Flex, and work with Flex GMs to prioritise them.

🧠 What you'll bring:


Essential Experience

  • Executive Product Leadership: Proven experience building and leading product organisations — not just managing product teams. You've shaped culture, developed people, and elevated the function around you.

  • Platform Product Expertise: Deep experience in platform or shared infrastructure product contexts — building capabilities that serve multiple internal customers with competing priorities, without losing coherence or quality.

  • Commercial Acumen: A track record of connecting product decisions to business outcomes and making the case for long-term platform investment in commercial terms. You can represent product strategy credibly to executive leadership.

  • Engineering Partnership: Genuine experience co-owning roadmaps and co-building organisations with engineering leadership as a peer — not a handoff relationship.

  • Organisational Complexity: Demonstrated ability to operate across multiple business units, market models, or geographies — making decisions that serve the whole without losing sight of the specific.


Leadership & Mindset

  • You possess a rare combination of strategic clarity and operational discipline — you can define where the platform needs to be in three years while staying close enough to delivery to know when something's going wrong today.

  • You are a product leader who builds organisations, not just products. The PMs around you get better because of you.

  • You thrive in environments where the answer isn't obvious. You can hold the tension between serving immediate business needs and protecting long-term platform integrity, and make good decisions in that space.

  • You embody the ability to "think long-term and ship next week."

 
 

⭐️ Bonus points:

  • Experience in energy trading, utilities, or distributed energy resources used for grid flexibility.

  • Experience building platforms that serve both internal proposition teams and external partners or customers.

  • Prior experience scaling a product organisation through a period of rapid, sustained growth.

  • Leverage AI daily: Use AI coding tools (Cursor, Claude Code…) for ~70% of your coding to review, refine and ship features faster.

jobs.description:
Wer wir sind.

Eine der führenden Kommunikationsagenturen im deutschen Raum mit mehr als 300 Mitarbeiter*innen. Wir bieten the full monty: Konzeption, Kreation, Redaktion, Organisation, Kampagnen, Social-Media und technologische Plattformen. Wir begleiten Kund*innen aus Wirtschaft, Politik, Gesellschaft und Medien. Und wir entwickeln alles, was diese für eine wirksame Kommunikation brauchen: Social Media-Kampagnen, Magazine, Fernsehspots und Websites. Von der strategischen Kernidee bis zur technischen Umsetzung. Am liebsten für die komplexen Themen unserer Zeit.
 
Die Position des*r Client Service Director ist bei RYSM INTEGRAL angesiedelt – die Digital Experience Unit der RYSM Agenturgruppe. Die Schwerpunkte von RYSM INTEGRAL sind Digital Strategie, CX-Beratung, Plattformen & Services, Datenportale & Websites.


Was zu tun ist.

Du möchtest nicht einzelne Digitalprojekte betreuen, sondern die Verantwortung für ein großes, langfristiges Kundenmandat übernehmen? Als Client Service Director trägst du bei uns die strategische, wirtschaftliche und kundenbezogene Gesamtverantwortung für eines unserer zentralen Mandate im Public Sector – an der Schnittstelle von Kund*innenberatung, Account Development und digitaler Delivery, unterstützt von einem erfahrenen Team aus Projektmanagement, Beratung, UX/UI, Technologie und Betrieb.
 
Was du verantwortest

  • Aufbau und Pflege langfristiger Beziehungen zu Entscheider*innen und zentralen Ansprechpartner*innen
  • tiefgreifendes Verständnis der Ziele, Roadmaps und Herausforderungen unserer Kund*innen, frühzeitige Reaktion und Lösungsvorschläge statt auf fertige Anfragen zu warten
  • Proaktive Entwicklung neuer Themen und Beratungsangebote (z. B. Plattform-Weiterentwicklung, UX, Technologie, Redaktionsprozesse, KI)
  • Verantwortung für Umsatz, Deckungsbeitrag und Forecast
  • Übergeordnete Begleitung großer Projekte, Unterstützung der Projektmanager*innen bei Meilensteinen und Eskalationen
  • Ausrichtung des kund*innenbezogenen Kernteams, Einbindung passender Spezialist*innen
  • Erkennen von Synergien, damit erfolgreiche Lösungen auch an anderer Stelle Mehrwert schaffen
  • Die operative Projektleitung liegt bei unseren Projektmanager*innen – du behältst die Perspektive auf das Gesamtmandat.


Was du mitbringst.

  • Mehrjährige Erfahrung in einer Digitalagentur, Digitalberatung oder vergleichbarem Umfeld
  • Erfahrung mit öffentlichen Auftraggeber*innen und Verständnis für Verwaltung und öffentliche Kommunikation
  • Erfahrung in der Beratung anspruchsvoller Kund*innen sowie mit größeren Website-, CMS- oder Plattformprojekten
  • Wirtschaftliches und unternehmerisches Denken, ausgeprägtes Gespür für Kund*innenbedarfe
  • Sicherheit im Umgang mit unterschiedlichen Stakeholdern, Fähigkeit, Teams auch ohne disziplinarische Verantwortung auszurichten
  • Gutes technisches Grundverständnis; TYPO3-Kenntnisse von Vorteil, keine Voraussetzung
  • Du musst heute noch keinen vergleichbaren Großaccount vollständig verantwortet haben – die Position eignet sich auch als nächster Schritt für erfahrene Senior Consultants, Account Manager*innen oder Senior Project Manager*innen mit dem Wunsch nach mehr strategischer und wirtschaftlicher Verantwortung.

Was die Rolle besonders macht
  • Ein großes, langfristig angelegtes Mandat mit erheblichem Gestaltungsspielraum.
  • Ein festes Kernteam, das du um weitere Spezialist*innen ergänzen kannst.
  • Die Möglichkeit, komplexe digitale Plattformen über mehrere Jahre hinweg mitzuprägen – statt möglichst viele Projekte selbst zu managen.
  • Für die Rolle ist regelmäßige persönliche Präsenz beim Kunden wichtig – daher suchen wir insbesondere jemanden mit Wohnsitz oder dauerhaftem beruflichem Schwerpunkt in der Region Rheinland-Pfalz/Mainz.


Wen wir suchen.

Eine*n Client Service Director für den Public Sector. Ab sofort. Mit beruflichem Schwerpunkt in der Region Rheinland-Pfalz/Mainz


Was wir bieten.

Keine Schokoriegel, sondern digitale Erlebnisse. Keine Turnschuhe, sondern Fitness für die graue Zellen. Weil: komplexe Themen – anspruchsvolle Kund*innen.  
Was noch? Kluge und sympathische Kolleg*innen. Relevante Auftraggebende. Inhaltlich Herausforderndes. Reichlich Abwechslung. Flache Hierarchien. Und die Chance, gemeinsam mit uns kräftig aufs Gas zu drücken. Wir stehen für familienfreundliches Arbeiten. Hybrid Work. Raum für individuelle Weiterentwicklung und fachbezogene Veranstaltungen. Und obendrauf mit RYSM INTEGRAL Teil der Hirschen Group und auf internationaler Ebene Partner von WPP zu sein.


Was, wenn's passt?

Dann sollten wir uns kennenlernen.

Wir freuen uns über jede Bewerbung von qualifizierten Menschen. Jeder geschlechtlichen und sexuellen Identität. Jeden Alters. Von Bewerbenden mit Migrationshintergrund, People of Colour  und / oder Menschen mit Behinderungen. Wiedereinsteiger*innen. Eltern. Quereinsteiger*innen. Alle sind bei uns gleichermaßen willkommen.

Schick uns gerne deine Bewerbungsunterlagen und lass uns wissen, wann du frühestens einsteigen kannst und wie deine Gehaltsvorstellungen sind. Wenn du möchtest, kannst du deine Unterlagen auch anonymisiert als Blind-Bewerbung einreichen – wir stellen einen fairen und transparenten Auswahlprozess sicher. Wir freuen uns auf dich.

Und noch ein Hinweis: Wir nehmen Informationssicherheit ernst – und freuen uns, wenn du diesen Anspruch mit uns teilst.


Deine Ansprechpartnerin.

Nicole Lilie

Our success is driven by deep expertise in technology and business processes, a superior product with strong product-market fit, reflected in an expanding customer base that includes Fortune 500 companies.

BLP is one of Switzerland's fastest-growing SaaS scale-ups; we are now entering our next phase of growth. From our headquarters on Zürich's Bahnhofstrasse, we're expanding globally, with a growing presence across Europe and North America.

Join us and help make autonomous operations the new standard.

Location

This is a full-time position based in Munich or Cologne. Following a comprehensive onboarding period at our HQ in central Zurich (minimum one month), you will work from your home location, with regular visits to customers across the DACH region.

Team collaboration matters a lot to us. You will regularly spend time with the team in person, in Zurich and at our hubs, for team days, all-hands and offsites. These visits are financially supported by blp.

Your Mission

You get customers live. Hands on, end to end, and fast.

As a Senior Project Manager, you make large, global blp transformations happen. These programs touch finance, procurement and supply chain at once, run across multiple ERP systems and legal entities, and roll out country by country. Your job is to orchestrate all of it and get the customer live: the first go-live above all, because that is where credibility is won or lost, and then wave after wave with the same discipline. You run the steering committee, you lead a blp team on each engagement, and you do that across several engagements at once.

At both levels, scope is the single biggest lever on whether a project goes live on time. Protecting it is a daily job, not a contract clause. You escalate early and precisely rather than absorbing problems until they become critical.

You will not be alone with the technical side. Integrations Engineers handle the connection into the ERP, Technical Project Managers handle the harder solution design, and our Consultants take over the automation work after go-live. On our largest strategic accounts a Client Partner carries the relationship and the commercial number, so your attention goes to delivery quality.

We have done this many times, so you are not inventing the approach each time. A proven onboarding method and a strong toolkit are what let you carry your own customers from early on.

Your Career Path in Project Management

This is the path most of our delivery leadership came through, and we hire at every step of it. We place you according to your experience and the size of the programs you have delivered, and we are explicit about what the next step requires.

  • Project Manager: You get customers live end to end, several in parallel: guided onboarding for commercial customers, leading enterprise projects yourself, or a workstream on our largest programs. Typically you bring 2+ years in consulting, implementation or project management.

  • Senior Project Manager: You make large, global transformations happen: multiple ERPs, entities and countries, the steering committee, and a blp team on each engagement. Typically you bring 5+ years delivering complex, multi-country programs.

  • Next steps: Lead a delivery team, or move into Consulting and from there towards our Client Partner role on strategic accounts.

Moves into Consulting or Customer Success Engineering are open at every level, and many of our people make them.

Key Responsibilities

  • Run implementations end to end: kick-off, scope, planning, configuration, testing and go-live.

  • Manage several customers in parallel at different stages, and keep every one of them on date.

  • Work with customers on their processes, and flag early where a process assumption will not hold.

  • Coordinate the specialists on your projects: Integrations Engineers, Technical Project Managers and AI Automation Specialists.

  • Own scope actively. Recognize a change request for what it is and handle it deliberately.

  • Keep the project inside its budget, and raise it early when the effort is drifting.

  • Hand over cleanly at go-live to our Consultants and support organization.

In addition, as a Senior Project Manager

  • Own the delivery outcome of global programs from kick-off to the last go-live: plan, scope, dependencies and date.

  • Drive the first go-live relentlessly, then run wave planning across ERPs, entities and countries.

  • Run the steering committee and own the decisions that come out of it.

  • Write and execute the recovery plan when a program is off track.

  • Lead the blp team on each engagement and coach the Project Managers working on your programs.

What We're Really Looking For

The following key attributes ensure success in this role:

  • Scope Discipline – You notice when a project is quietly growing, and you raise it rather than absorbing it.

  • Ownership & Autonomy – You take initiative, move things forward, and deliver end to end without being chased.

  • Escalation Judgment – You escalate early, to the right person, with a proposal rather than a problem.

  • Client Confidence – You are comfortable running a meeting with a customer's finance or IT lead in it.

  • Four-Language Fluency – Technology, process, data and people. You speak each well enough to spot where a roadblock really sits.

  • Structured Under Pressure – When a project goes sideways you get sharper and more organized, not louder.

What You Bring

  • 5+ years of experience delivering complex projects: management consulting, enterprise software implementation, or large-scale transformation delivery.

  • Proven track record running multi-country or multi-entity programs with senior client stakeholders, and steering a committee that includes client executives.

  • Experience leading a delivery team rather than only a plan.

  • Strong analytical and communication skills. You can translate a business need into something a technical team can act on.

  • Fluent in German and English, spoken and written.

  • Bonus points for ERP implementation experience, finance or supply chain processes, or AI-driven SaaS.

Benefits

  • High ownership environment – you shape your projects, outcomes, and career path.

  • Impact at scale – your work powers automation across global enterprises.

  • Cross-functional exposure – work with engineers, data scientists, and business leaders daily.

  • Real growth – fast-paced environment, steep learning curve, and structured career progression.

  • Employee ownership – be part of a majority employee-owned company with a best-in-class stock option program.

  • Amazing team – become part of a driven and collaborative group of innovators.

  • Technology exposure – be at the forefront of AI and enjoy continuous learning opportunities.

  • Visits & offsites – paid visits and stays at our HQ in Zurich, including collaborative team offsites.

Ready to build the future of ERP automation? Join us and own your impact.

Learn more about blp and our values at https://blp.digital/company/careers.

jobs.description:
Le Product Management, c'est notre ADN.

Chez Hubvisory, tu ne te contentes pas de gérer un backlog : tu deviens la référence produit incontournable pour accompagner nos clients grands comptes dans la transformation de leurs produits digitaux et de leurs organisations. Ton rôle est d'allier vision stratégique et excellence opérationnelle pour délivrer de la valeur tangible dans des environnements complexes.

Ce que tu fais concrètement :

  • Tu prends la main sur un périmètre produit à fort enjeu business. Tu analyses les processus en place, tu identifies les leviers d'amélioration réels et tu formalises une vision produit et une feuille de route alignées sur les priorités métier.

  • Tu décides avec la donnée. Tu mesures l'effet de tes arbitrages sur l'usage et la performance commerciale, tu construis les indicateurs qui manquent, et tu transformes une analyse en recommandation argumentée. Pas en tableau de bord de plus.

  • Tu traduis le besoin métier en produit. Exigences fonctionnelles, user stories, critères d'acceptation, priorisation que tu assumes et que tu sais défendre.

  • Tu interviens sur le socle SI. Tu contribues au cadrage et à l'évolution des briques applicatives concernées, en gardant la main sur le pourquoi quand tout le monde discute du comment.

  • Tu alignes un écosystème dense. Métiers, produit, data, IT : tu fais converger des parties prenantes multiples vers des décisions cohérentes, et tu accompagnes l'adoption des solutions auprès des équipes.

  • Tu documentes ce qui compte. Processus, décisions, dépendances, évolutions fonctionnelles : ce que tu laisses derrière toi tient sans toi.

  • Tu participes à la vie d'Hubvisory. Tu consolides ta posture de consultant, tu partages tes retours d'expérience et tu évolues, selon tes aspirations, vers des rôles de Product Leader ou Manager Conseil.

  • Tu as travaillé sur des briques IA (recommandation, agents, GenAI) ou tu as une appétence réelle pour intégrer l'IA au cycle produit. On cherche des PM qui qualifient les cas IA avant de les mettre en place, pas des PM qui militeraient pour de l'IA partout.

👉 Pourquoi rejoindre Hubvisory ?

  • Hubvisory est le seul cabinet en France focalisé exclusivement sur le Product Management et l'IA. Pas de practice data généraliste, pas de conseil en transformation sur tous les sujets. On fait une chose, on la fait bien.

  • Un parcours d'accompagnement sur-mesure. Nos rituels collectifs (Hub'Times) et nos revalorisations bi-annuelles récompensent la vraie progression, pas l'ancienneté.

  • Une communauté interne engagée : 20% des collaborateurs se sont volontairement engagés à travers plus de 20 projets à impact menés depuis 2022 (mécénat de compétence, organisation de maraudes, fresque du climat, etc.)

  • Des valeurs fortes : depuis 10 ans, Hubvisory grandit autour de la bienveillance, la méritocratie, l'ambition, l'expertise et l'apprentissage.

Le package : 44.000-52.000€ fixe brut, revalorisations bi-annuelles, intéressement jusqu'à 22% des profits redistribué de façon égalitaire.


Pré-requis du poste

👉 Le profil que nous recherchons

  • Tu justifies d'au moins 5 ans d'expérience en tant que Product Manager ou Product Owner sur des produits digitaux, dont une expérience significative en écosystème complexe : plusieurs métiers, plusieurs systèmes, des décisions qui ne se prennent jamais seul.

  • Tu sais mener un sujet produit de la discovery aux critères d'acceptation, et tu as déjà porté une vision et une feuille de route face à des parties prenantes exigeantes.

  • Ta maturité data est réelle : tu interprètes toi-même les chiffres, tu structures des hypothèses, tu mesures pour décider.

  • Tu es à l'aise pour contribuer au cadrage fonctionnel de briques applicatives structurantes, sans y perdre ta hauteur de vue produit.

  • Un passage par le commerce, le e-commerce ou la supply chain, en particulier sur les sujets d'offre et de référencement, est un vrai plus. Une familiarité avec un progiciel de gestion de type SAP également.

  • Trois qualités qui font la différence ici : une posture conseil assumée, une excellente communication client et une rigueur analytique à toute épreuve. Anglais professionnel.

Comment se déroule le processus de recrutement ?

  • Étape 1 : Echange avec un RH pour valider l'adéquation entre ton projet et notre modèle

  • Etape 2 : Validation de tes hard skills avec cas pratique avec un manager

  • Étape 3 : Validation de tes soft skills avec un entretien avec un VP

  • Etape 4 : Echange téléphonique avec un RH pour la proposition d'embauche

Quelle que soit l'issue de ton process, tu reçois un retour de notre part sous 7 jours maximum !

Si tu veux plus d’information sur notre processus de recrutement, on en a fait un article sur notre blog.
