Dotfile is building the AI-native Compliance Operating System for financial institutions. Our mission is to make compliance simple, safe and smart, helping financial institutions onboard customers, manage risk and operate globally.

 

Compliance remains one of the most manual functions in financial services. While most institutions still rely on fragmented tools and human-driven workflows, we believe AI is enabling a fundamental shift toward autonomous compliance. Our ambition is to build Level 5 Compliance: software that can gather evidence, investigate complex situations, assess risk and execute defensible decisions under defined policies.

 

Dotfile has grown into one of Europe’s fastest-growing compliance technology companies. Today, 100+ financial institutions across 15 countries rely on Dotfile for critical compliance operations, with a rapidly growing presence in the US.

 

We recently raised our Series A from leading US and European investors and software operators. We’re now entering our next chapter: investing heavily in product and AI, expanding internationally, and building the team that can make Dotfile the global standard for compliance infrastructure.

Role Overview

We are looking for a highly analytical, technical and hands-on Director of Growth to build and scale Dotfile’s growth engine.

You will own how we identify target accounts, capture buying signals, reach the right people with the right message, experiment with new channels, and turn what works into scalable systems. You will work closely with Marketing and Sales to generate qualified pipeline across our key markets, with a particular focus on our expansion in the US.

This is a builder role. You will combine strong growth instincts with data, automation and AI to build workflows for account research, enrichment, segmentation, personalization, campaign execution and analysis. You will own the full experimentation loop: finding opportunities, launching experiments quickly, measuring their impact on pipeline and revenue, and scaling the ones that work.

You will be expected to remain deeply hands-on with the tools and systems behind our growth engine. We want to build a small, highly leveraged growth team where technology replaces repetitive work and allows us to experiment faster and operate at greater scale.

You will report directly to the VP of Marketing.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own Dotfile’s growth strategy and pipeline generation across our key markets, working closely with Marketing and Sales

  • Build systems to identify target accounts and buying signals, enrich them with relevant data, and turn them into actionable growth opportunities

  • Design and execute highly targeted outbound and account-based campaigns across channels, using AI and automation to operate at scale without sacrificing relevance

  • Build workflows and agents for research, enrichment, segmentation, personalization, campaign execution and analysis

  • Develop a high-velocity experimentation engine: identify new audiences, messages, channels and tactics, launch tests quickly, measure their impact and scale what works

  • Own the growth stack and connect our CRM, data providers, automation tools, AI models and other systems to continuously improve how we generate pipeline

  • Own growth analytics and performance, developing a clear understanding of funnel conversion, pipeline contribution, CAC and channel effectiveness

  • Partner closely with Sales and Marketing to turn learnings from prospects, customers and campaign performance into better targeting, messaging and go-to-market decisions

About you

  • You have 5+ years of experience in Growth, Growth Engineering, Demand Generation, Marketing Operations or another highly analytical role in B2B SaaS

  • You have a track record of building growth programs that generated measurable pipeline and revenue, not just traffic, leads or engagement

  • You are technically strong and comfortable working with data, APIs, webhooks, CRM systems, enrichment providers and automation tools

  • AI is already part of how you work. You use LLMs and agents to research, build, analyze and execute, and naturally look for new things to automate

  • You are a builder. You are comfortable connecting tools, creating workflows, manipulating data and prototyping solutions yourself rather than relying on others to do it for you

  • You combine strong growth intuition with analytical rigor and can move comfortably between an idea, a dataset, an experiment and its impact on pipeline

  • You thrive in a fast-moving environment with high standards and strong ownership. You are comfortable building from scratch, running multiple experiments in parallel and quickly changing direction when the data tells you to

  • Experience growing an enterprise B2B SaaS business internationally, particularly in the US, is a plus

The interview process

Round 1: First conversation to get to know you, understand what drives you, and explore why this role excites you.

Round 2: Two-part discussion where you’ll walk us through your career journey and the choices that shaped it, followed by a values-based interview.

Round 3: Deep dive into one of your key projects with someone from a different team, offering a fresh, cross-functional perspective on how you work.

Round 4: Practical exercise, case study tailored to the role, giving you the opportunity to showcase your skills on a real-world challenge.

Round 5: Final conversation with our founder.

jobs.title: Software Engineer, Command Centre (Frontend & UI/UX)
jobs.description:
Our Mission

At Laelaps AI, we believe robotics is entering a transformative decade, much like the arrival of the internet. Advances in AI, cloud computing, and hardware are reshaping what autonomous systems can do. Our mission is to build the intelligent software that powers physical security in the real world - enabling robots and sensors to handle dangerous and critical tasks that humans shouldn't have to. By engineering the orchestration layer for intelligent security, we aim to create a world that is safer, more secure, and more resilient.

We're a strong founding team based in Zurich, backed by visionary investors and advisors. We are engineering the future of security today!

The Role

You will build the Command Centre, the screen an operator uses to see what our robots and cameras see, decide in seconds, and task the fleet. Soldiers have already run our console unaided after a short introduction. Next, one operator watches many sites, and tasks robots in plain language instead of drawing routes. That needs an interface built for it.

This role is engineering and design in one. You will shape the flows, prototype them, test them with operators, and ship them in production code, working with our full-stack engineer on the backend and our vision engineers on what the models show.

What You'll Work On

  • Operator interface: live video, site maps, robot positions and alerts in one view that works at 03:00.

  • Alert triage: the flow from alert to decision: evidence, context, confirm or dismiss, dispatch a robot.

  • Tasking by instruction: an interface for telling the fleet what to do in plain language, and seeing how it plans to do it.

  • Design system: components and patterns that keep the product consistent as it grows.

  • Usability: prototype, test with operators, measure, iterate.

jobs.title: Senior Product Engineer (TypeScript) - Platform
jobs.description:
Our team shared’s mission is deploy AI agents to transform how patients and doctors connect

We believe healthcare shouldn’t be defined by missed calls, endless waiting lines, and overwhelmed staff. Patients and professionals deserve better.

Vocca builds AI voice agents that answer every call instantly, schedule and reschedule appointments, and free up staff to focus on what matters most: care.

Already trusted by 15 000+ providers, we’re transforming the patient–provider relationship, one call at a time.

Want to shape the future of healthcare?

Join us !

  • Discover our company culture and values

  • Here is a product teaser

  • Eliott's interview for Welcome to the jungle

  • Eliott's quick interview for Speedinvest

  • Articles on our A round (techfundingnews, Maddyness, les echos, our blog)

The problem

Every medical centre has its own rules. Who can book what, with which practitioner, at what time, what to do with an urgent case at 6 pm. Today these rules live in prompts and in the heads of our ops team. Each new clinic takes hours of manual work, and the ops team is the bottleneck of our growth.

We are building the platform that removes that bottleneck. A scenario engine where the behaviour of the agent is structured configuration, not free text. A self-serve onboarding where a clinic connects its software and sets itself up. A dashboard where the medical staff stop executing and start supervising: the agent handles the volume, humans check what matters.

This is the difference between selling a service and selling a product. It decides how fast Vocca can grow and how many clinics one ops person can support. The long term vision is simple: a clinic signs, connects its software and is live within days, without a single developer involved. You would be building that.

What you will own

The product and its architecture

  • The architecture of the scenario engine and the configuration model. One product that handles the rules of thousands of medical centres without becoming a swamp.

  • The self-serve onboarding, from the backend to the dashboard. Today a clinic deployment went from days to under an hour thanks to internal tooling. The next step is zero developer ticket on a standard onboarding.

  • The dashboard our clinics use all day. Fast, reliable and clean enough that a medical secretary prefers it to the phone. We take frontend quality seriously and we have just created a product designer role to raise the bar.

  • The technical roadmap of the platform, built with the product manager and the ops team. You decide what we build first, what we build simply and what we do not build.

The quality bar

  • What "done" means on the platform: tests, reviews, monitoring, and what we check before a change reaches 1,000 medical staff.

  • Reliability in production. When the dashboard or an onboarding breaks, you own the fix and the reason it does not happen again.

The team

  • The engineering team is growing fast and will organise in squads. You will define how this one works: reviews, documentation, technical decisions.

  • You will work daily with a confirmed engineer (2 to 5 years of experience) who joins the platform team at the same time. Their growth is part of your job.

  • You will take part in hiring the next engineers of the team, and you will help onboard them.

  • You will be one of the most experienced engineers in the company and we will expect you to act like it.

Stack

TypeScript everywhere, backend and frontend (Node, monorepo), PostgreSQL, a design system written in code.
We are migrating our last Python services to TypeScript over the coming months.

How we build

  • We use AI seriously. Agents in every workflow, Claude Max provided. A migration estimated at 3 months was done in 2 weeks.

  • For this role we are looking for the senior who frames the work first, sets guardrails and reviews carefully.

  • We ship the version that works, then fix the last 1% when it shows up. With AI, this trade off is much cheaper than before. But the judgment about what not to touch is yours.

  • Every change lands in front of more than 1,000 medical staff who use the product all day. We talk every day with the ops team that deploys clinics and the sales team that sells the product.

Who does well here

  • 5+ years building full-stack products in production, mostly in startups or fast growing companies where you had to decide with incomplete information.

  • Strong in TypeScript, backend and frontend. A real eye for interface quality and the discipline to follow a design system.

  • You have turned a manual process into a product before, or you really want to.

  • You had good practices before AI: solid system design, clean refactoring and a good nose for the risks of generated code that nobody tested.

  • You can say no, reduce the scope and explain a technical decision to a founder in two minutes.

What we expect from you

First week

  • Get onboarded on the stack.

  • Ship your first improvement on the dashboard.

First month

  • Own one feature end to end, from the spec with the ops team to production.

  • Write down how the platform should evolve.

First 3 months

  • The first version of the scenario engine is in production.

  • A standard clinic can be onboarded without a developer ticket.

6 to 12 months

  • Most new clinics are live within 7 days.

  • Clinics configure their own rules in the dashboard.

  • The platform team has its own way of working, and you have hired at least one engineer into it.

Process: 4 steps, fast

  1. 45 min with Nans (Talent).

  2. 45 min with Pierrick, Head of Engineering.

  3. 1h30 in our office with the engineering team, with live coding without AI and a real conversation about product architecture.

  4. 30 min with Hugo, CTO.

Then references and an offer. When the match is obvious, we have made an offer in 24 hours. You get feedback at every step.

Practical

  • Paris, rue d'Alexandrie (Sentier), new offices.

  • 70-90K + BSPCE.

  • Hybrid 3 days at the office.

  • Claude Max provided.

We aim to keep the process within 30 days. You’ll receive continuous feedback throughout.

Why should you join Vocca?

  • An entrepreneurial adventure, with a supportive, high-energy, execution-focused team

  • A product already live, with delighted customers in a fast-growing market (healthcare automation, voice AI)

  • A true scaling phase, with everything still to build

  • Real responsibilities from day one

We hire people, not roles.

If you're excited about our opportunities but don't check every box, we'd love to hear from you. Everyone, no matter how underrepresented, should feel free to apply as it can only bring learnings or success. If you identify yourself as a woman: Did you know that research shows women often apply only when meeting 100% of requirements?

We'll be thrilled to receive your application!

Help us use technology to make a big green dent in the universe!

Kraken powers some of the most innovative global developments in energy.

It’s an incredibly exciting time to work in energy. Join us on our mission to improve the lives of ONE BILLION humans within the decade and shape a cleaner, better future for everyone.

🏡 Where you'll fit in:
KrakenFlex is the flexibility arm of the Kraken group, built to put a big green dent in global carbon emissions by rewriting how electricity grids operate. We stabilize the grid and help renewables come online much faster by managing the second-by-second balance of clean power. Right now, our platform connects nearly one million assets worldwide, putting over 6GW of live load under our direct control.

Behind the scenes, that means handling massive technical scale: solving complex optimization problems in real time and processing 15 billion data readings a day from the latest green technologies, ensuring the grid stays reliable without relying on old fossil-fuel backup plants.

The next phase of our journey involves monumental growth. Currently operational across multiple countries, we are poised for further global expansion, scaling our asset base and tackling unique grid challenges in new territories. Our mission is to integrate an increasingly diverse array of green flexibility assets while ensuring our market-leading platform remains exceptionally stable and performant.

What is Optimisation in Flex?
The Optimisation chapter is the mathematical and algorithmic engine of the KrakenFlex platform. While other chapters manage physical asset connectivity or ingest market signals, this domain is responsible for the intelligence that decides exactly what every asset should do, second by second, to maximise both grid stability and financial returns.

The teams within this chapter build and maintain the real-time dispatch engines, predictive forecasting models, and algorithmic solvers that handle massive multi-asset portfolios. This involves translating complex market rules, physical asset constraints (like battery degradation curves, state-of-charge limits, and ramp rates), and fluctuating price signals into optimised execution strategies.

The defining challenge for this chapter is scaling computational performance alongside our rapid asset growth. Running complex, multi-variable mathematical models in tight real-time windows requires immense efficiency. The core tension lies in balancing the demand from data science and quantitative engineering to introduce increasingly sophisticated models with the strict platform requirement for absolute reliability, low latency, and cost-effective cloud compute.

Ultimately, this chapter must move away from bespoke optimisation routines tailored to individual markets or asset types. Your goal is to architect a highly performant, modular optimisation core that uses standard abstract layers, allowing us to roll out new algorithms or expand into new global territories without rewriting the underlying engine.

🚀 What you’ll own:
The Flex platform is built on autonomous Chapters, which are collections of specialists focused on delivering a core service or business outcome, defined by the unchanging nature of the energy business (independent of technology, hardware, or regional differences). A Head of Engineering leading a Chapter is a senior leadership role combining strong product thinking, engineering judgement, operational awareness, and people leadership. They manage managers and senior individual contributors, helping teams own their product surfaces, make sound trade-offs, and deliver reliably.

This role requires influencing beyond its formal remit, spotting cross-team patterns, clarifying ownership and decision-making, and driving initiatives to turn recurring issues into visible actions with owners, dates, and measures of success. Ultimately, they maintain the technical vision for their specific area, ensuring services are appropriately owned, maintained, and aligned with Flex's sustainable growth.

  • Ensuring the services in that area are owned and maintained appropriately.

  • Ensuring that product features are built in a way that scales, is cost-effective, and is in line with the vision for a product area.

  • Ensuring the appropriate level of quality and resilience, with a specific focus on reducing system incidents and improving stability.

  • Ensuring appropriate tech debt is prioritised to support sustainable delivery.

  • Potentially managing a squad (team) as well.

🧠 What you’ll bring to the party:
You’ll be a strong fit if you have experience leading engineering teams across multiple squads, teams or product areas in a complex product environment.

  • A collaborative product and engineering mindset: you care about customer outcomes, product strategy, technical quality and the people needed to make the work real.

  • Strong judgement in ambiguity: you can separate urgent from important, make trade-offs explicit and help teams move without pretending all uncertainty has disappeared.

Als Werkstudent:in im Bereich Talent Acquisition übernimmst du echte Verantwortung bei der Identifikation und Ansprache von Führungskräften und begleitest Kandidat:innen entlang des gesamten Recruiting-Prozesses. Du unterstützt unser Executive Recruiting für Deutschland, Polen und globale Positionen, baust belastbare Talent-Pipelines auf und sorgst dafür, dass jede:r Kandidat:in eine erstklassige Erfahrung erlebt. Dabei lernst du die vollständige Wertschöpfungskette anspruchsvoller Personalgewinnung in einem international wachsenden Unternehmen kennen.

PERGOLUX entwickelt und verkauft skandinavisch inspirierte Outdoor-Living-Produkte wie Pergolen und Gartenmöbel direkt an Endkund:innen. Mit rund 300 Mitarbeiter:innen, einem neunstelligen Umsatz und Präsenz in acht Ländern gehören wir zu den am beständigsten wachsenden Unternehmen unserer Branche.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Du recherchierst und identifizierst Führungskräfte über LinkedIn, Boolean Search, interne Tools und kreative Ansprachestrategien und baust starke Pipelines über Funktionen und Märkte hinweg auf.

  • Du steuerst die Candidate Journey vom ersten Kontakt bis zur Shortlist, koordinierst Ansprache, Follow-ups und Updates und sorgst für eine durchgehend hochwertige Kandidat:innen-Erfahrung.

  • Du wirst schrittweise in erste Kandidat:innen-Screenings eingearbeitet und trägst zur Bewertung im Auswahlprozess bei, inklusive Einblick in Interviews und Assessment-Frameworks.

  • Du beobachtest Branchentrends, Talentbewegungen und Organisationsstrukturen von Wettbewerbern und erstellst daraus strategische Talent Maps.

  • Du pflegst aktuelle Pipeline-Reports und teilst relevante Erkenntnisse mit den Hiring-Teams, um datenbasierte Entscheidungen zu ermöglichen.

Dein Profil

  • Du studierst HR, BWL, Psychologie oder ein verwandtes Fach (Bachelor/Master) und hast noch mindestens 2–3 Semester Studienzeit vor dir.

  • Du hast erste Erfahrung in Recruiting, HR oder anspruchsvollem Kund:innenkontakt; Interesse an Executive Search und strategischem HR sind ein Plus.

  • Du kommunizierst klar und empathisch auf sehr gutem Deutsch (C1) und fließendem Englisch, stellst durchdachte Fragen und gehst gerne auf Menschen zu.

  • Du arbeitest strukturiert und verbindlich, hältst Prozesse in Bewegung und behältst Pipelines und Fortschritte im Blick.

  • Du bewegst dich sicher in Sourcing-Plattformen, ATS-Systemen und Tabellen und gehst mit sensiblen Informationen diskret und vertrauensvoll um.

💼 Vergütung — 16 € pro Stunde (brutto)

🗺️ Bürostandort – Schlesische Str. 27 C, 10997 Berlin

🚀 Entwicklung und Karriere — Du wirst von erfahrenen Executive Recruitern gecoacht, übernimmst von Beginn an echte Verantwortung für deine Pipelines, arbeitest in einem internationalen, kollaborativen Team über ganz Europa hinweg und kannst mit dem Wachstum von PERGOLUX in Fach- und Führungsrollen hineinwachsen.

⏰ Urlaub und Flexibilität

  • Start ab sofort

  • ca. 20 Stunden/Woche, flexibel um deine Vorlesungen und Prüfungen herum, in den Semesterferien nach Absprache mehr

  • hybrides Arbeiten mit Präsenz im Berliner Büro

  • bis zu 30 Urlaubstage, beginnend bei 27

  • eine Woche Remote-Workation pro Jahr in der EU/UK

🌟 Benefits und Lifestyle

  • Jobrad / Bike-Leasing-Programm für nachhaltiges und gesundes Pendeln

  • Moderne Ausstattung und Laptops (Apple oder Windows)

  • Mitarbeiter:innen-Rabatte auf PERGOLUX-Produkte

  • Team-Kultur mit regelmäßigen Events (Sommerfest, Weihnachtsfeier, After-Work-Treffen) und Retreats

So bewirbst du dich

Klingt das nach deinem nächsten Schritt? Dann bewirb dich über unsere Career Page oder finde uns auf LinkedIn. Wir freuen uns darauf, von dir zu hören.

PERGOLUX ist ein Arbeitgeber der Chancengleichheit. Wir begrüßen Bewerbungen von Menschen mit unterschiedlichem Hintergrund, denn es geht uns weniger darum, jedes Kästchen abzuhaken, als darum, was du einbringst!

jobs.title: Senior Projektmanager:in Beiersdorf (Schweiz) - Social Media & Influencer Marketing (gn)
jobs.description:
Jobbeschreibung

Intermate x SAMY – Shaping the State of Social

Intermate gehört zu den größten Social-Media- und Influencer-Agenturen im DACH-Raum. Mit mehr als 250 Mates in Berlin, Hamburg, Köln und Remote entwickeln wir Social-First-Strategien, produzieren Content in eigenen Studios, arbeiten eng mit Creator:innen zusammen und steuern Kampagnen datengetrieben über unsere eigene Technologie. Unsere Kund:innen sind einige der bekanntesten Marken der Welt – von Lifestyle über FMCG bis hin zu Tech.

Als Teil von SAMY, einem globalen Agenturnetzwerk für Social Media und Creator Marketing, sind wir mit über 970 Expert:innen an 20 Standorten vernetzt. Das eröffnet internationale Perspektiven, Projekte in rund 55 Märkten und die Möglichkeit, dich weit über Ländergrenzen hinweg weiterzuentwickeln.

HINWEISE:

💡 👉 Unser Bewerbungsprozess wird teilweise von einem KI-gestützten Assistenten begleitet, der das erste Kennenlerngespräch führt. Weitere Informationen erhältst du im Verlauf deiner Bewerbung.

🇨🇭 Diese Position ist in der Schweiz angesiedelt und richtet sich an Menschen, die vor Ort in der Schweiz leben und arbeiten möchten. Du arbeitest dabei mit einem Remote-Vertrag – flexibel, digital und bestens vernetzt. Da wir auch mit französischsprachigen Kund:innen und Partner:innen arbeiten, freuen wir uns besonders über sehr gute Französischkenntnisse. 💬✨

WAS DU MACHST

  • Du übernimmst die Verantwortung für die Durchführung von Influencer-Marketing-Kampagnen – inklusive Controlling sowie Termin-, Kosten- und Qualitätsprüfung.
  • Du koordinierst und steuerst alle beteiligten Stakeholder – von Influencer:innen und Kund:innen über Kreation und Produktion bis hin zum Paid- und Social-Team.
  • Du wirkst gemeinsam mit dem Kreativ-Team an der Entwicklung von Kampagnenkonzepten mit.
  • Du betreust und planst Foto- und Video-Produktionen.
  • Du erstellst Kampagnenanalysen, Kundenpräsentationen und Reportings für Influencer- und Social-Media-Kampagnen.
  • Du berätst unsere Kund:innen aktiv und entwickelst die Zusammenarbeit kontinuierlich weiter.

Stellenanforderungen

WAS DU BRAUCHST

  • Du bringst mindestens vier Jahre Berufserfahrung im Marketing-Umfeld mit.
  • Du hast eine große Leidenschaft für Social Media und bereits einschlägige Erfahrung im Influencer Marketing gesammelt.
  • Du bist erfahren im Umgang mit großen Kund:innen und hohen Kampagnenbudgets.
  • Du verfügst über ausgeprägte Beratungs- und Moderationsstärke.
  • Du arbeitest hands-on und zeichnest dich durch eine starke Problemlösefähigkeit aus.
  • Du beherrschst Deutsch und Englisch sehr gut in Wort und Schrift & bringst gute Französischkenntnisse mit

WAS WIR DIR BIETEN

  • Onboarding & Support
    No one likes to be the new kid. Mit strukturiertem Onboarding, einem persönlichen Mate und Zugang zu Lernmaterialien bist du ab Tag eine:r von uns.
  • Erstklassige Ausstattung
    Can’t work without my iPhone. Mit MacBook, iPhone und aktueller Apple-Tech arbeitest du flexibel und effizient. Das gilt für unsere Altbau-Offices genauso wie zuhause oder unterwegs.
  • Wachstum & Weiterentwicklung
    Rise & shine, darling! Dein jährliches Weiterbildungsbudget gibt dir die Freiheit, in Workshops, Seminare, zertifizierte Kurse oder Coachings zu investieren. So entwickelst du dich genau in die Richtung, die zu deinen Zielen passt.
  • Flexibel arbeiten
    „Ob das bei euch gerade genauso ist? I doubt it!” Bis zu sechs Wochen im Jahr kannst du innerhalb der EU remote arbeiten. Unsere flexiblen Arbeitszeitmodelle machen es leicht, Arbeit und Leben in Einklang zu bringen. Bei einem Umzug oder in besonderen Lebenssituationen wie einem Trauerfall erhältst du zusätzliche freie Tage.
  • Mehr Freizeit
    „It’s my birthday, I’mma spend my money.“ An deinem Geburtstag heißt es: Laptop zu und genießen. Zusätzlich sind der 24. Dezember und der 31. Dezember frei. Jubiläen und Geburtstage feiern wir mit kleinen Überraschungen.
  • Health & Wellbeing
    Hot girl walk or heavy lift? Mit der Urban Sports Club Mitgliedschaft entscheidest du selbst, ob Yoga, Pilates, Schwimmen oder Krafttraining zu deinem Glow Up passt. nilo.health sorgt für mentale Stärke und bietet Sessions mit Psycholog:innen oder Coaches. Über deinen Zugang können auch bis zu fünf Familienmitglieder mitmachen.
  • Exklusive Deals & Extras
    It’s giving… perks! Profitiere von attraktiven Rabatten bei Partnern wie plantclub, FutureBens und vielen mehr. Zusätzlich kannst du eines dieser drei Benefits wählen:
  • Givve Card – 50 € Guthaben pro Monat, frei einsetzbar für alles, was du liebst.
  • Mobiko – 65 € monatliches Mobilitätsbudget, nutzbar für Deutschlandticket, Tankkosten und alles, was kostet, um von A nach B zu kommen.
  • Betriebliche Altersvorsorge – 50 € monatlicher Zuschuss zu deiner betrieblichen Altersvorsorge.

Außerdem sind unsere Offices dog-friendly. Snacks, Obst und Drinks stehen allen Mates jederzeit kostenlos zur Verfügung.

jobs.title: Head of Accounting
jobs.description:
Job title: Head of Accounting

Reports to: Chief Financial Officer (CFO)

Direct Reports: 2 Accounting Team Members

Scope: Global Accounting Oversight for PUR Group Entities

Location: Paris, France

Contract: Local, Permanent, Full time

About PUR

PUR is a global B Corp helping companies act for climate, nature and people through nature-based projects. 

Since 2008, we have worked with leading companies to restore ecosystems, support farmers and communities, and build more resilient supply chains. Our projects include agroforestry, regenerative agriculture, reforestation, and ecosystem restoration, across more than 30 countries. 

We work closely with local partners, farmers, cooperatives, NGOs and businesses to design projects that are adapted to each landscape and community. This local approach is key to creating long-term impact — for the climate, biodiversity, soil, water, and livelihoods. 

Today, PUR has more than 200 team members across 16 countries, with key offices in Paris and Toronto. As the world faces growing climate and biodiversity challenges, PUR is helping global companies move from ambition to action. 

Position Summary

The Heah of Accounting is responsible for ensuring the accuracy, integrity, and compliance of PUR's accounting records and financial reporting across the Group. The role oversees day-to-day accounting operations, coordinates monthly and annual closings, manages statutory and tax compliance, and serves as the primary accounting counterpart for Regional Accounting and Finance Managers in Latin America, Africa, and Asia.

You will lead a team of two accounting professionals and contribute to the continuous improvement of accounting processes, internal controls, and reporting systems to support PUR's growth and international operations.

Key Responsibilities

Accounting Operations & Financial Close

  • Lead the monthly, quarterly, and annual closing processes for Group entities.

  • Ensure timely and accurate recording of accounting transactions in accordance with local GAAP and Group accounting policies.

  • Review and validate general ledger entries, balance sheet reconciliations, and supporting schedules.

  • Monitor accruals, provisions, prepaid expenses, fixed assets, and intercompany transactions.

  • Ensure consistency and accuracy of accounting practices across entities.

Group Coordination

  • Act as the primary accounting liaison with Regional Accounting and Finance Managers in: Latin America, Africa and Asia

  • Coordinate closing calendars, reporting packages, and accounting guidelines.

  • Support regional teams in resolving complex accounting matters and ensuring compliance with Group policies.

  • Review key accounting judgments and significant transactions across regions.

Statutory Accounts & Compliance

  • Coordinate preparation of annual statutory financial statements.

  • Ensure compliance with local accounting, tax, and regulatory requirements.

  • Manage relationships with external auditors, tax advisors, accountants, and regulatory authorities.

  • Support the preparation of audit files and responses to audit requests.

  • Monitor evolving accounting and regulatory requirements and ensure appropriate implementation.

Consolidation & Group Reporting

  • Support the preparation of consolidated financial information for management and shareholders.

  • Ensure timely submission of reporting packages from regional entities.

  • Review intercompany balances and transactions and coordinate reconciliation processes.

  • Assist in the implementation and maintenance of Group reporting standards.

Internal Controls & Process Improvement

  • Maintain robust accounting controls and documentation.

  • Identify opportunities to automate and streamline accounting activities.

  • Strengthen financial controls, accounting procedures, and reporting accuracy.

  • Contribute to ERP and finance system optimization initiatives.

Treasury & Cash Management Support

  • Monitor cash accounting and treasury-related transactions.

  • Ensure proper accounting treatment of financing arrangements, loans, and intercompany funding.

  • Support working capital management through accurate balance sheet monitoring.

Team Management

  • Lead, coach, and develop two accounting team members.

  • Allocate responsibilities and monitor workload to ensure efficiency and quality.

  • Promote a culture of accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement.

  • Support training and professional development initiatives.


We are looking for a candidate with:

  • Master’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field.

  • DEC, CPA, ACCA, or equivalent is a plus.

  • 8+ years of accounting experience in an international environment.

  • Experience leading accounting teams and managing audits.

  • Multi-country accounting exposure preferred.

  • Audit firm experience is a plus.

  • Strong knowledge of French GAAP and international accounting standards.

  • Consolidation, intercompany accounting, and multi-currency environments.

  • ERP experience (NetSuite is a plus).

  • Advanced Excel skills.

  • Leadership and stakeholder management.

  • Strong analytical and organizational skills.

  • Attention to detail and accuracy.

  • Ability to work across cultures and time zones.

Key Success Factors

During the first 12 months, the successful candidate will:

  • Ensure timely and accurate monthly closings across all entities.

  • Improve balance sheet reconciliation quality and documentation.

  • Strengthen collaboration with regional finance teams.

  • Enhance accounting controls and audit readiness.

  • Contribute to the standardization and automation of accounting processes.

  • Support the continued scalability of PUR's global finance function.

At PUR, we strive to build inclusive teams and an equitable workplace where our employees feel respected, supported, and empowered. As a global company operating across six continents, we recognize that diversity in the workplace is essential to achieving our mission. 

We welcome applications from all qualified candidates regardless of age, race, gender, colour, religion, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, or any other aspect that makes them unique.

PUR is dedicated to providing an accessible environment for all candidates during the application process and for employees during their employment.  If you require accommodation or consideration throughout the interview process, let us know, and we will do our best to support you.

jobs.title: Solutions Engineer, Payments Infrastructure
jobs.description:
OVERVIEW

Formance builds programmable financial infrastructure. Our open-source ledger helps engineering teams model, track, and reconcile money movements across financial products, from payment platforms to fintech applications and digital-asset businesses.

Financial infrastructure requires precision. Teams need to understand where money is, how it moves, and whether their systems reflect what actually happened. We build the tools to help them answer those questions.

YOUR ROLE

We’re looking for a Solutions Engineer with a strong technical foundation and experience in fintech or payments to join our team.

You’ll work with prospective customers to understand their architecture, map their financial flows, and demonstrate how Formance fits their requirements. You’ll partner closely with our sales, product, and engineering teams throughout the evaluation process.

This role combines technical depth with commercial judgment. You should be comfortable building a proof of concept, discussing architectural tradeoffs with an engineer, and explaining the business implications to a founder.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

  • Lead technical discovery with engineering and product teams to understand their financial workflows, constraints, and evaluation criteria.

  • Build tailored demos and proofs of concept using Formance’s APIs and tooling.

  • Guide technical evaluations, investigate questions, and help prospects assess product fit.

  • Partner with sales to connect technical capabilities to business needs and move opportunities forward.

  • Bring customer feedback to product and engineering, with concrete examples of gaps and recurring needs.

REQUIREMENTS

  • Experience in fintech, payments, banking infrastructure, or digital-asset infrastructure. You understand how money moves through a financial product and the operational challenges involved.

  • A strong technical foundation. You can work with APIs, read and write code, debug integrations, and reason about data models and system architecture.

  • Experience working directly with customers, through solutions engineering, solutions architecture, technical consulting, or an engineering role with significant customer exposure.

  • The ability to ask precise questions, uncover requirements, and explain complex concepts clearly.

  • Commercial judgment: you understand how a technical evaluation contributes to a buying decision.

  • A hands-on approach and the ability to work independently in a small team.

  • Strong written and spoken English, with the ability to lead technical conversations with international customers.

Useful additional experience

  • Working with ledgers, double-entry accounting, reconciliation, or payment orchestration.

  • Supporting technical evaluations for API-first or developer-facing products.

  • Building financial workflows involving multiple currencies, payment providers, or digital assets.

  • Turning recurring customer questions into reusable demos, documentation, or tools.

WHY JOIN FORMANCE?

You’ll work directly with teams building financial products and help them make consequential infrastructure decisions.

You’ll have ownership of technical evaluations, close access to product and engineering, and the opportunity to shape how we demonstrate and explain Formance. Your work will influence both customer decisions and the product we build.

BENEFITS

  • Flexible remote work policy

  • Health insurance: Alan Blue, with your partner and dependent children covered at no cost from day one.

  • Meal vouchers: €10 per day worked, with 55% covered by Formance.

  • Equipment: A MacBook from day one, plus a €500 onboarding budget for your workspace equipment.

  • Parenthood support: Formance maintains 100% of your salary during the first month of additional birth leave.

Scality is looking for an experienced Demand Generation Campaign Manager to own our global campaign program. You plan, launch, and optimize the campaigns that generate qualified leads and opportunities across our enterprise and mid-market go to market in the Americas, EMEA, and Asia Pacific.

You’ll also be plugged into Voodoo's shared gaming backend platform - the same architecture and patterns that power titles like Mob Control and Block Jam 3D - building on it and contributing back, in close collaboration with the wider backend team. You get the focus and ownership of a dedicated game engineer with the leverage and support of a battle-tested platform behind you.

This is a pivotal hire: Castle Busters is moving towards competitive multiplayer, which means moving game logic from the client to the server. You will be central to that transition.

Role

You will design and build the server-side foundation that takes Castle Busters from a client-authoritative game to a competitive, server-validated one. The current game computes everything on the device - progression, economy, and match outcomes alike, which won't hold up for competitive PvP. Your job is to change that.

Working closely with client developers and game designers from feature design through delivery, validation and iteration, you will:

  • Build server-side validation for the metagame - currency, card upgrades, chest opens, and progression - staged by risk, replicating economy and reward logic on the server.

  • Move toward server authority for competitive features, where game state lives in one place and can be trusted.

  • Design APIs and player-state management that the Unity client integrates against, and help shape how client and server split responsibilities.

The responsibilities are cross-functional, ranging from infrastructure, API design & coding all the way to client-side integration (we are using Golang).

To succeed in this role, you will need to have passion for everything you do. You love to write code that scales to millions of users, are skilled at requirements gathering, champion new tech initiatives & leverage existing solutions.

Profile

  • 7+ years of backend development experience

  • Strong knowledge of computer science fundamentals

  • Extreme fluency in Golang (At least 1 year in a professional environment)

  • Mastery of SQL and NoSQL

  • Background in high-scale systems

  • Understanding of Unix-like environments

  • Experience working in cross-functional agile teams

  • Strong analytical skills with a track record of solving complex problems related to scalability, performance, and integration in high-stakes environments.

  • Excellent interpersonal and communication skills, capable of influencing teams and interfacing effectively with various stakeholders.

  • Ability to be self sufficient and work autonomously.
